value.rationale: For a physically motivated echo observable, the exact sign of numerical attenuation affects interpretation of diffusion signal, even when a splitting solver is stable. The theorem classifies every nonuniform mesh using an O(N) exact PSD test, proves uniform time steps are uniquely order-symmetric for all echo pulses, gives exact second-order echo cancellation on those meshes, and sharply demonstrates why a locally reasonable adjacent ratio bound fails for three steps. These are actionable mesh/pulse design restrictions beyond reporting a scalar quadrature error; no general PDE or imaging performance claim is made.
